value: SELECT o.hk_offer, s.departure_time, s.arrival_time, CASE WHEN s.stops IN ('non-stop','nonstop','none','zero','0') THEN 0 WHEN s.stops IN ('one','1','1 stop','1_stop') THEN 1 WHEN s.stops IN ('two','2','2 stop','2_stop','2 stops') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS stops, s.class, s.duration, ROUND(s.duration * 60) AS duration_min, s.days_left, s.price, NOW() AS load_dts, 'stg_flights_offers_raw' AS record_source FROM stg.flights_offers_raw s JOIN rdv.hub_offer o ON o.offer_bk = s.idx::text
